name: trenchworks-mobile
description: Capacitor (iOS/Android) shell for Trenchworks: WW2 — the game core lives at the repo root; scripts/sync-www.mjs stages it into www/ byte-identical at build time (cap sync has no exclude support, so webDir cannot be the repo root).

scripts.sync:demo: TW_DEMO_BUILD=1 node scripts/sync-www.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:demo: npm run sync:demo && npx cap run android --flavor demo
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
